title: Redeeming Wanderlane Traveller Club Points against a Travel Booking
content:
**Points of judgement from the service desk training pack of the Wanderlane Traveller Club.**

**On what basis are points redeemed?** Points are redeemed against a travel booking at the redemption value of the tier held. The money value of a redemption is the number of points redeemed multiplied by the tier's redemption value in US cents for each point, that total in cents then expressed in US dollars. On hypothetical figures: 20000 points redeemed on a card whose redemption value stands at 1.2 US cents for each point, a figure chosen for this illustration only, come to 24000 US cents, which is 240.00 US dollars.

**A member asks to redeem below the tier's minimum.** A redemption below the tier's minimum is refused rather than rounded up.

**When may points be spent at all?** Points are spent only while the membership record stands at active. The membership record is the authority, and it must stand at active before the redemption is recorded against that membership.

**How is the rest of the price settled?** A redemption is settled in points only. The balance of the price is collected in money, and a booking is never held part-paid.

**An award booking is to be changed or cancelled.** An award booking may be changed against the tier's award change fee and cancelled against its award cancel fee. On cancellation the points return to the card carrying their original expiry.

**The card stands at suspended, or at closed.** Points on a suspended card may not be spent. Points on a closed card are forfeited without payment of any kind.

**The member redeems very often.** A member who has made more than the annual ceiling of 24 redemptions is referred to the programme office before any further redemption, because the pattern requires review. The redemptions counted are those recorded against the same membership in the 12 months ending on the day the matter is handled, counted back day by day from that day.

| Redemptions recorded in those 12 months | What follows |
|---|---|
| 24 or fewer | The ceiling is not passed |
| More than 24 | The member is referred to the programme office before any further redemption |
